description: Source code for NGAP common structures and methods, including PrivateIE-ID and PrivateIE-Field handling, with serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice between local and global private IE IDs, with methods for setting, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for handling private IE fields, including packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for container items of private IEs, supporting packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to local type and returns reference to c.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to global type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit_ref or cbit_ref.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit_ref or cbit_ref.
